name: castle_v1
doc: A part of a castle (design/planner.md, Castles): the game asks for a part (a config entry: the keep, a great hall, a chapel, barracks, stables, a kitchen, storehouses, a tower), its lot's size, and the season; build makes it on its lot, and the house animator sways its banners, swings its bell, raises its smoke, and opens its door.

params.name: part
params.doc: A part: one entry from config/castle_v1_parts/.

params.name: size
params.doc: Its lot: small (rect6x5), medium (rect8x6), large (rect10x7), or keep (rect8x8). A planner gives the part's own size.

params.name: theme
params.doc: The village's theme from config/village_v1_themes/: its roofs, turrets' tops, colours, ornaments, and fires (heartland keeps the part's own).

params.name: stage
params.doc: How far it has come: planning (staked out, its trench dug, stone piled), half (walls half up in scaffolding), finished, or a ruin (broken, roofless, overgrown).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.

params.name: door_time
params.doc: Seconds since its door opened; negative while shut. The game starts it when someone comes through; it opens, stays a moment, and closes.
